items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: As soon as you started out Jaffe came out and said, you really hear the bass tonight?

ctx.x: That's right, when it hit that wall, that tone's gone, yes Lord. The guy came and asked me, he said, what you got, an amplifier on there? I said no, I don't have no. He said, yeah you got, he said, what makes that bass sound so loud? I said it was just the way I played.
Just the way you played it. As soon as you started out Jaffe came out and said, you really hear the bass tonight?

Yeah. So he looked, he said, man, he said look over there. He said you play as hard. I said I always did, ever since I knew my pitch. I was playing at 8th and Ramport. I was playing at the Bulls Club. Yeah. And you can hear my fiddle from 8th and Ramport to Claiborne and 3rd at the National Park.
